name: prereason
description: Bitcoin and macro market briefings for your assistant: trend signals, regimes, liquidity and ETF flows. Needs no key to start; approve one link and the key arrives on its own.
long_description: PreReason returns market context an assistant can reason with instead of raw numbers: 19 briefings across Bitcoin, macro liquidity, FX and cross-asset correlations, each with trend signals and confidence scores (the deeper ones add regime classification and causal narratives), plus 212 individual metrics with interpretation. The three catalogue tools work without an account. When a briefing needs a key, the extension asks for access from inside the conversation: you open one link, sign in or create a free account, click Approve, and the key is saved on this computer, attached to your account. Nothing is created without that approval.

api_key.title: PreReason API key
api_key.description: Optional. Leave empty: the extension asks for access from inside Claude and you approve one link. Paste a pr_live_ key here only if you already have one.
